This is an odd image: a white bowl sits on a wooden board, and the bowl holds curled brown and cream pieces. They look like wood shavings or possibly pastry or bread curls, but I'll treat them as food.

The bowl is about 15 cm across at the rim, and it appears around 160 px wide in the image. The contents fill most of it, but they are light and curly, so I estimate about 60 g in total. I'll split that into roughly 30 g of cream-colored pieces and 30 g of brown pieces.

I'll treat the cream pieces as bread or dough at about 260 kcal/100 g and the brown pieces as cooked meat or pastry at about 250 kcal/100 g.
